# NIM-ARCADE

> Web3 arcade gaming platform built as a Nimiq Pay Mini App.

NIM-ARCADE lets players earn real NIM cryptocurrency by playing 30 arcade
and brain-training games, competing in online tournaments, and converting
accumulated XP to NIM tokens — all without leaving the Nimiq Pay app.

## What is NIM-ARCADE?

NIM-ARCADE is a play-to-earn arcade platform built on the Nimiq blockchain.
It runs as a Mini App inside Nimiq Pay, using the Nimiq Mini App SDK for
wallet integration. Players never need to manage private keys or set up
external wallets — Nimiq Pay handles all of that.

## How the XP Economy Works

- Every game awards XP based on score and difficulty multiplier
- 1,000 XP = 0.001 NIM (conversion rate)
- Daily earning cap: 50,000 XP per day with progressive reduction
  - First 5,000 XP: 100% rate
  - Next 5,000 XP: 70% rate
  - Remaining: 40% rate
- Anti-farming: device identifier via Nimiq SDK, rate limits, score validation

## Games (30 total)

### Brain Training
- Memory Matrix — memorize lit grid patterns
- Color Stroop — name ink color, not the word
- Dual N-Back — working memory training
- Number Flow — mental arithmetic chains
- Pattern Sync — complete visual sequences
- Focus Grid — selective attention
- Speed Sort — rapid classification
- Word Flux — verbal fluency

### Classic Arcade
- Nimtris — Tetris with combo scoring
- Hex Fall — Block Blast group clearing
- Snake Path — classic snake
- Space Raid — vertical shoot-em-up
- Breakwall — Breakout/Arkanoid
- Pac Maze — maze chaser
- Asteroid Field — Asteroids-style
- Frog Cross — Frogger-style
- Pong Duel — 1v1 online paddle

### Action
- Hex Runner — endless runner (available now)
- Quick Tap — reflex tapping (available now)
- Gravity Switch — flip gravity corridor
- Neon Blade — swipe-to-slice
- Dodge Storm — projectile survival
- Tower Stack — precision stacking

### Puzzle
- Memory Rush — card matching with timer (available now)
- Merge Hex — 2048 on hexagonal grid
- Color Path — connect matching colors
- Shift Blocks — slide puzzle
- Hex Flow — pipe rotation puzzle
- Light Bounce — mirror reflection puzzle
- Sum Path — arithmetic path puzzle

## Pricing

Free to play. No purchase required.

- Solo games: FREE
- Tournament entry: 0.001–0.05 NIM per tournament
- Online rooms: 0.001–0.01 NIM optional entry fee
- Prize distribution: 70% first place, 20% second, 10% third
- Platform fee: 5% of tournament prize pools

## Technology

- Frontend: React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Blockchain: Nimiq Web Client, Nimiq Mini App SDK
- Wallet: Nimiq Pay (custody — no private key exposure)
- Multiplayer: WebSocket server (coming)
- Backend: Node.js + Express + Supabase (coming)

## Key URLs

- App: https://nim-arcade.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/NIMIQ-MINIAPPS/NIMIQ-ARCADE
- Nimiq Pay: https://nimiq.com/pay

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do I need a wallet to play?**
No. NIM-ARCADE runs inside Nimiq Pay which manages your wallet automatically.

**Is it free to play?**
All 30 games are free. Tournaments have optional entry fees starting at 0.001 NIM.

**How do I earn NIM?**
Play games to earn XP. Convert XP to NIM at 1,000 XP = 0.001 NIM through your Nimiq Pay wallet.

**What is Nimiq?**
Nimiq is a browser-native blockchain focused on ease of use and accessibility.
NIM is its native cryptocurrency.
